mapper.insert: INSERT INTO B_CNTR_AMT ( cntr_ymd ,upper_locgov_code ,upper_locgov_nm ,locgov_code ,locgov_nm ,cntr_amt ,pre_amt ,cntr_cnt ,pre_cnt ,amt_rate ,cnt_rate ,frst_reg_dt ) SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYYMMDD') CNTR_YMD , CURR.upper_locgov_code , CURR.upper_locgov_nm , CURR.locgov_code , CURR.locgov_nm , CURR.cntr_amt , PRE.pre_amt , CURR.cntr_Cnt , PRE.pre_Cnt , TO_CHAR(ROUND(CURR.cntr_Cnt * 1.0 / PRE.pre_Cnt * 100 - 100 ,1)) as amt_rate , TO_CHAR(ROUND(CURR.cntr_amt * 1.0 / PRE.pre_amt * 100 - 100 ,1)) as cnt_rate , DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') frst_reg_dt from ( select clg.upper_locgov_code , clg.upper_locgov_nm , clg.locgov_code , clg.locgov_nm , count(1) AS cntr_Cnt , sum(cntr_amt) AS cntr_amt FROM g_cntr gc JOIN g_locgov clg ON clg.locgov_code = gc.cntr_locgov_code WHERE 1=1 AND gc.cntr_sttus_code = '200' AND substr(cntr_de, 1,8) <TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYYMMDD') AND substr(cntr_de, 1,8) >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY') || '0101' GROUP BY clg.locgov_code ) CURR left outer join ( select clg.upper_locgov_code , clg.upper_locgov_nm , clg.locgov_code , clg.locgov_nm , count(1) AS pre_Cnt , sum(cntr_amt) AS pre_amt FROM g_cntr gc JOIN g_locgov clg ON clg.locgov_code = gc.cntr_locgov_code WHERE 1=1 AND gc.cntr_sttus_code = '200' AND substr(cntr_de, 1,8) < to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY'))-1 || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'MMDD') AND substr(cntr_de, 1,8) >= to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY'))-1 || '0101' GROUP BY clg.locgov_code ) PRE on CURR.locgov_code = PRE.locgov_code

MERGE INTO B_CNTR_AMT_MM bcam USING( SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY') CNTR_YY , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'mm') CNTR_MM , gl.upper_locgov_code , gl.upper_locgov_nm , gl.locgov_code , gl.locgov_nm , NVL(CURR.cntr_amt,0) cntr_amt , NVL(PRE.pre_amt,0) pre_amt , TO_CHAR(ROUND( CASE WHEN NVL(PRE.pre_amt,0) = 0 AND NVL(CURR.cntr_amt,0) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN NVL(PRE.pre_amt,0) = 0 AND NVL(CURR.cntr_amt,0) > 0 THEN 100 ELSE (((NVL(CURR.cntr_amt,0) * 1.0) - (PRE.pre_amt * 1.0)) / (PRE.pre_amt * 1.0)) * 100 END ,1)) AS amt_rate , DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') frst_reg_dt from G_LOCGOV gl left outer join ( select clg.upper_locgov_code , clg.upper_locgov_nm , clg.locgov_code , clg.locgov_nm , count(1) AS cntr_Cnt , sum(cntr_amt) AS cntr_amt FROM g_cntr gc JOIN g_locgov clg ON clg.locgov_code = gc.cntr_locgov_code WHERE 1=1 AND gc.cntr_sttus_code = '200' AND substr(cntr_de, 1,6) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYYMM') GROUP BY clg.locgov_code ) CURR ON gl.locgov_code = CURR.locgov_code left outer join ( select clg.upper_locgov_code , clg.upper_locgov_nm , clg.locgov_code , clg.locgov_nm , count(1) AS pre_Cnt , sum(NVL(cntr_amt,0)) AS pre_amt FROM g_cntr gc JOIN g_locgov clg ON clg.locgov_code = gc.cntr_locgov_code WHERE 1=1 AND gc.cntr_sttus_code = '200' AND substr(cntr_de, 1,6) = to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY'))-1 || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'MM') GROUP BY clg.locgov_code ) PRE on gl.locgov_code = PRE.locgov_code ) t ON (bcam.cntr_yy = t.cntr_yy AND bcam.cntr_mm = t.cntr_mm AND bcam.locgov_code = t.locgov_code) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET bcam.cntr_yy = t.cntr_yy ,bcam.cntr_mm = t.cntr_mm ,bcam.upper_locgov_code = t.upper_locgov_code ,bcam.upper_locgov_nm = t.upper_locgov_nm ,bcam.locgov_code = t.locgov_code ,bcam.locgov_nm = t.locgov_nm ,bcam.pre_amt = t.pre_amt ,bcam.cntr_amt = t.cntr_amt ,bcam.amt_rate = t.amt_rate ,bcam.frst_reg_dt = t.frst_reg_dt WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( cntr_yy ,cntr_mm ,upper_locgov_code ,upper_locgov_nm ,locgov_code ,locgov_nm ,pre_amt ,cntr_amt ,amt_rate ,frst_reg_dt ) VALUES ( t.cntr_yy ,t.cntr_mm ,t.upper_locgov_code ,t.upper_locgov_nm ,t.locgov_code ,t.locgov_nm ,t.pre_amt ,t.cntr_amt ,t.amt_rate ,t.frst_reg_dt );

INSERT INTO B_CNTR_AMT_BIZ ( cntr_ymd ,upper_locgov_code ,upper_locgov_nm ,locgov_code ,locgov_nm ,cntr_amt ,biz_amt ,cntr_rate ,biz_rate ,frst_reg_dt ) select rs.CNTR_YMD , rs.upper_locgov_code , rs.upper_locgov_nm , rs.locgov_code , rs.locgov_nm , rs.cntr_amt , rs.biz_amt , TO_CHAR(ROUND(rs.cntr_amt * 1.0 / rs.tot_amt * 100 ,1)) as Cntr_rate , TO_CHAR(ROUND(rs.biz_amt * 1.0 / rs.tot_amt * 100 ,1)) as biz_rate , DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') frst_reg_dt from ( SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') CNTR_YMD , clg.upper_locgov_code , clg.upper_locgov_nm , clg.locgov_code , clg.locgov_nm , SUM(case when dsgn_dntn_biz_id = 0 then cntr_amt else 0 end) as cntr_amt , SUM(case when dsgn_dntn_biz_id != 0 then cntr_amt else 0 end) as biz_amt , SUM(cntr_amt) as tot_amt from g_cntr gc JOIN g_locgov clg ON clg.locgov_code = gc.cntr_locgov_code where 1=1 AND gc.cntr_sttus_code = '200' AND substr(gc.cntr_de, 1,8) < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYYMMDD') AND substr(gc.cntr_de, 1,8) >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY') || '0101' GROUP BY clg.locgov_code ) rs

INSERT INTO B_CNTR_BIZ( cntr_ymd ,upper_locgov_code ,upper_locgov_nm ,locgov_code ,locgov_nm ,biz_nm ,cntr_amt ,cntr_rate ,cntr_status ,frst_reg_dt ) SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYYMMDD') CNTR_YMD , clg.upper_locgov_code , clg.upper_locgov_nm , clg.locgov_code , clg.locgov_nm , GDNB.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_TTL AS biz_nm , CNTR.TOTAL_CNTR_AMT AS cntr_amt , TO_CHAR(ROUND((CNTR.TOTAL_CNTR_AMT * 1.0) / (GDNB.GOAL_AMT * 1.0) * 100 ,1)) AS cntr_rate , case WHEN GDNB.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_STTS_CD = 2 THEN '진행중' ELSE GDNB.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_STTS_CD END AS cntr_status , DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') frst_reg_dt FROM G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_MNG GDNB INNER JOIN G_LOCGOV clg ON GDNB.LCLGV_CD = clg.LOCGOV_CODE INNER JOIN ( SELECT DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID , SUM(CNTR_AMT) AS TOTAL_CNTR_AMT FROM G_CNTR WHERE 1 = 1 AND DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID != 0 GROUP BY DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID ) CNTR ON CNTR.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID = GDNB.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND GDNB.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_STTS_CD = 2 ORDER BY clg.LOCGOV_CODE;

INSERT INTO B_CNTR_PATH ( cntr_ymd ,upper_locgov_code ,upper_locgov_nm ,locgov_code ,locgov_nm ,cntr_path ,cntr_amt ,cntr_rate ,frst_reg_dt ) SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYYMMDD') CNTR_YMD , clg.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE , clg.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM , clg.LOCGOV_CODE , clg.LOCGOV_NM , gcl.platform_bucket , SUM(gcl.cntr_amt) AS cntr_amt , TO_CHAR(ROUND((SUM(gcl.cntr_amt) * 1.0) / (SUM(SUM(gcl.cntr_amt) * 1.0) OVER(PARTITION BY gcl.cntr_locgov_code)) * 100 ,1)) AS cntr_rate , DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') frst_reg_dt from ( SELECT cntr_locgov_code , case when gc.cntr_path_code = 100 and (occ.detail IS NULL or occ.detail = '고향사랑e음' or occ.detail = '') then '고향사랑e음' when gc.cntr_path_code = 100 and occ.detail = '위기브' then '민간연계' when gc.cntr_path_code = 100 and occ.detail = '액티부키' then '민간연계' when gc.cntr_path_code = 100 and occ.detail = '웰로' then '민간연계' when gc.cntr_path_code = 100 and occ.detail = 'KB국민은행' then '민간연계' when gc.cntr_path_code = 100 and occ.detail = 'IBK기업은행' then '민간연계' when gc.cntr_path_code = 100 and occ.detail = '신한은행' then '민간연계' when gc.cntr_path_code = 100 and occ.detail = '하나은행' then '민간연계' when gc.cntr_path_code = 100 and occ.detail = 'NH농협은행' then '민간연계' when gc.cntr_path_code = 100 and occ.detail = '체리' then '민간연계' when gc.cntr_path_code = 100 and occ.detail = '디투홈' then '민간연계' when gc.cntr_path_code = 100 and occ.detail = '광주은행' then '민간연계' when gc.cntr_path_code = 100 and occ.detail = 'e제너두' then '민간연계' when gc.cntr_path_code = 100 and occ.detail = '디지털지갑' then '민간연계' when gc.cntr_path_code = 200 and (occ.detail = '' or occ.detail is null) then '농협창구' -- 오프라인기부 end as platform_bucket , cntr_amt from g_cntr gc left join op_common_code occ on occ.id = gc.link_instt_cd and occ.code_type = 'LINK_INSTT_CD' and occ.use_yn = 'Y' where 1=1 and gc.cntr_sttus_code = 200 ) gcl JOIN g_locgov clg ON clg.locgov_code = gcl.cntr_locgov_code GROUP BY cntr_locgov_code, gcl.platform_bucket ORDER BY cntr_locgov_code

insert into b_cntr_amt_cat( cntr_ymd ,upper_locgov_code ,upper_locgov_nm ,locgov_code ,locgov_nm ,cntr_cost ,cntr_cnt ,cntr_rate ) select cntr_ymd , upper_locgov_code , upper_locgov_nm , locgov_code , locgov_nm , txt as cntr_cost , cntr_cnt , case when r_amt > 0 then TO_CHAR(ROUND((cntr_amt * 1.0) / (r_amt * 1.0) * 100 ,1)) else '0' end AS cntr_rate from( select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYYMMDD') CNTR_YMD , clg.upper_locgov_code , clg.upper_locgov_nm -- 기부지자체광역지역 , clg.locgov_code , clg.locgov_nm , concat(clg.upper_locgov_nm, ' ', clg.locgov_nm) AS "기부지자체" -- 기부지자체코드 , base.txt as txt , base.ord as ord , NVL(t1.cntr_cnt,0) as cntr_cnt , NVL(t1.cntr_amt,0) as cntr_amt , sum(NVL(cntr_amt,0)) over (partition by cntr_locgov_code) as r_amt from ( select r2.locgov_code ,r1.txt ,r1.ord from ( SELECT '10만원 미만' AS txt , 1 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '10만원' AS txt , 2 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '10만원 초과 ~ 20만원 미만' AS txt , 3 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '20만원' AS txt , 4 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '20만원 초과 ~ 2000만원 미만' AS txt , 5 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '2000만원' AS txt , 6 AS ord FROM db_root ) as r1 cross join ( select locgov_code FROM g_locgov where use_at = 'Y' ) r2 ) base left outer join ( select gc.cntr_locgov_code , CASE WHEN cntr_amt < 100000 THEN '10만원 미만' WHEN cntr_amt = 100000 THEN '10만원' WHEN cntr_amt > 100000 AND cntr_amt < 200000 THEN '10만원 초과 ~ 20만원 미만' WHEN cntr_amt = 200000 THEN '20만원' WHEN cntr_amt > 200000 AND cntr_amt < 20000000 THEN '20만원 초과 ~ 2000만원 미만' WHEN cntr_amt >= 20000000 THEN '2000만원' END AS "금액대" , sum(CASE WHEN substr(cntr_de, 1,4) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY') THEN cntr_amt ELSE 0 end) AS cntr_amt , count(CASE WHEN substr(cntr_de, 1,4) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY') THEN 1 ELSE null end) AS cntr_cnt FROM g_cntr gc WHERE gc.cntr_sttus_code = '200' AND substr(cntr_de, 1,4) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY') GROUP BY cntr_locgov_code, "금액대" ) AS t1 on t1.cntr_locgov_code = base.locgov_code AND t1."금액대" = base.txt LEFT JOIN g_locgov clg ON clg.locgov_code = base.locgov_code order by "기부지자체" , base.ord )

insert into b_cntr_old( cntr_ymd ,upper_locgov_code ,upper_locgov_nm ,locgov_code ,locgov_nm ,cntr_old ,cntr_cnt ,cntr_rate ) select cntr_ymd , upper_locgov_code , upper_locgov_nm , locgov_code , locgov_nm , cntr_old , cntr_cnt , case when r_cnt > 0 then TO_CHAR(ROUND((cntr_cnt * 1.0) / (r_cnt * 1.0) * 100 ,1)) else '0' end AS cntr_rate from ( select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYYMMDD') CNTR_YMD , clg.upper_locgov_code , clg.upper_locgov_nm , clg.locgov_code , clg.locgov_nm , concat(clg.upper_locgov_nm, ' ', clg.locgov_nm) AS "기부지자체" -- 기부지자체코드 , base.txt as cntr_old , base.ord , NVL(t1.cntr_cnt,0) as cntr_cnt , NVL(t1.cntr_amt,0) as cntr_amt , sum(NVL(t1.cntr_cnt,0)) over (partition by clg.locgov_code) as r_cnt from ( select r2.locgov_code ,r1.txt ,r1.ord from ( SELECT '20대 미만' AS txt , 1 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '20대' AS txt , 2 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '30대' AS txt , 3 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '40대' AS txt , 4 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '50대' AS txt , 5 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '60대' AS txt , 6 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '70대 이상' AS txt , 7 AS ord FROM db_root ) as r1 cross join ( select locgov_code FROM g_locgov where use_at = 'Y' ) r2 ) base left outer join ( select gc.cntr_locgov_code , CASE WHEN oud.birthday is null THEN '미상' WHEN datediff(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(oud.birthday, 'yyyymmdd'))/365 < 20 THEN '20대 미만' WHEN datediff(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(oud.birthday, 'yyyymmdd'))/365 >= 20 and datediff(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(oud.birthday, 'yyyymmdd'))/365 < 30 THEN '20대' WHEN datediff(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(oud.birthday, 'yyyymmdd'))/365 >= 30 and datediff(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(oud.birthday, 'yyyymmdd'))/365 < 40 THEN '30대' WHEN datediff(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(oud.birthday, 'yyyymmdd'))/365 >= 40 and datediff(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(oud.birthday, 'yyyymmdd'))/365 < 50 THEN '40대' WHEN datediff(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(oud.birthday, 'yyyymmdd'))/365 >= 50 and datediff(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(oud.birthday, 'yyyymmdd'))/365 < 60 THEN '50대' WHEN datediff(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(oud.birthday, 'yyyymmdd'))/365 >= 60 and datediff(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(oud.birthday, 'yyyymmdd'))/365 < 70 THEN '60대' WHEN datediff(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(oud.birthday, 'yyyymmdd'))/365 >= 70 THEN '70대 이상' END AS age_term , sum(CASE WHEN substr(cntr_de, 1,4) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY') THEN cntr_amt ELSE 0 end) AS cntr_amt , count(CASE WHEN substr(cntr_de, 1,4) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY') THEN 1 ELSE null end) AS cntr_cnt FROM g_cntr gc LEFT JOIN op_user_birthday oud ON gc.user_id = oud.user_id WHERE gc.cntr_sttus_code = '200' AND substr(cntr_de, 1,4) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY') GROUP BY cntr_locgov_code, age_term ) AS t1 on t1.cntr_locgov_code = base.locgov_code AND t1.age_term = base.txt LEFT JOIN g_locgov clg ON clg.locgov_code = base.locgov_code order by "기부지자체" , base.ord );

INSERT INTO b_cntr_addr( cntr_ymd ,upper_locgov_code ,upper_locgov_nm ,locgov_code ,locgov_nm ,cntr_locgov ,cntr_amt ,cntr_rate ,frst_reg_dt ) /* 기부자 거주 개별 자치단체 TOP 10 */ /* 건수순위 */ SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYYMMDD') CNTR_YMD , upper_locgov_code , "기부지자체광역지역" , cntr_locgov_code , locgov_nm -- , psitn_locgov_code , "거주지자체" -- , "기부건수" , "기부금액" , TO_CHAR(ROUND(("기부금액" * 1.0) / (SUM("기부금액") OVER(PARTITION BY "기부지자체") * 1.0) * 100 ,1)) AS cntr_rate , DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') frst_reg_dt FROM ( select "기부지자체광역지역" , upper_locgov_code , "기부지자체" , "거주지자체" , locgov_nm , cntr_locgov_code , psitn_locgov_code , "기부건수" , "기부금액" , rank()over(PARTITION BY "기부지자체" ORDER BY "기부금액" desc) AS "금액순위" FROM ( SELECT clg.upper_locgov_nm AS "기부지자체광역지역" -- "기부지자체광역지역" , clg.upper_locgov_code , concat(clg.upper_locgov_nm, ' ', clg.locgov_nm) AS "기부지자체" -- "기부지자체코드" , clg.locgov_nm , concat(plg.upper_locgov_nm, ' ', plg.locgov_nm) AS "거주지자체" -- "거주지자체코드" , gc.cntr_locgov_code , gc.psitn_locgov_code , count(1) AS "기부건수" , sum(cntr_amt) AS "기부금액" FROM g_cntr gc LEFT JOIN g_locgov plg ON plg.locgov_code = gc.psitn_locgov_code LEFT JOIN g_locgov clg ON clg.locgov_code = gc.cntr_locgov_code LEFT JOIN op_user_detail oud ON gc.user_id = oud.user_id WHERE 1=1 AND gc.cntr_sttus_code = '200' AND substr(gc.cntr_de, 1,4) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY') --AND cntr_locgov_code = '47170' GROUP BY "기부지자체광역지역","기부지자체","거주지자체" ) AS t1 ) AS tt ORDER BY "기부금액" DESC ;

insert into b_gift_usepoint ( cntr_ymd , upper_locgov_code , upper_locgov_nm , locgov_code , locgov_nm , cntr_point , cntr_rate ) select cntr_ymd , upper_locgov_code , upper_locgov_nm , locgov_code , locgov_nm , cntr_point , TO_CHAR(NVL(pnt_rate,0)) as cntr_rate from( select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYYMMDD') CNTR_YMD , CURR.upper_locgov_code , CURR.upper_locgov_nm , CURR.locgov_code , CURR.locgov_nm , CURR.cntr_point , PRE.pre_point , ROUND(CURR.cntr_point * 1.0 / PRE.pre_point * 100 - 100 ,1) as pnt_rate from ( select clg.upper_locgov_code , clg.upper_locgov_nm , clg.locgov_code , clg.locgov_nm , sum(cntr_use_point) AS cntr_point FROM g_cntr_use_point up JOIN g_locgov clg ON clg.locgov_code = up.cntr_locgov_code WHERE 1=1 AND substr(point_use_de, 1,8) < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYYMMDD') AND substr(point_use_de, 1,8) >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY') || '0101' GROUP BY clg.locgov_code ) CURR left outer join ( select clg.upper_locgov_code , clg.upper_locgov_nm , clg.locgov_code , clg.locgov_nm , sum(cntr_use_point) AS pre_point FROM g_cntr_use_point up JOIN g_locgov clg ON clg.locgov_code = up.cntr_locgov_code WHERE 1=1 AND substr(point_use_de, 1,8) < to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY'))-1 || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'MMDD') AND substr(point_use_de, 1,8) >= to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY'))-1 || '0101' GROUP BY clg.locgov_code ) PRE on CURR.locgov_code = PRE.locgov_code )

insert into b_gift_cnt ( cntr_ymd , upper_locgov_code , upper_locgov_nm , locgov_code , locgov_nm , gift_cnt ) select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYYMMDD') CNTR_YMD , gl.upper_locgov_code , gl.upper_locgov_nm , gl.locgov_code , gl.locgov_nm , count(it.item_id) as gift_cnt FROM ( SELECT I.ITEM_ID FROM OP_ITEM I INNER JOIN OP_SELLER S ON I.SELLER_ID = S.SELLER_ID AND S.STATUS_CODE = '2' WHERE 1=1 AND I.DATA_STATUS_CODE IN ('0', '1', '90') AND I.ITEM_DATA_TYPE = '1' GROUP BY I.ITEM_ID ) IT INNER JOIN OP_ITEM I ON IT.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID INNER JOIN OP_SELLER S ON I.SELLER_ID = S.SELLER_ID inner join g_locgov gl on s.locgov_code = gl.locgov_code group by CNTR_YMD, gl.upper_locgov_code, gl.upper_locgov_nm, gl.locgov_code, gl.locgov_nm

insert into B_GIFT_USEPOINT_CPR( CNTR_YMD , upper_locgov_code , upper_locgov_nm , locgov_code , locgov_nm , all_use_point , use_point ) select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYYMMDD') CNTR_YMD , sepa.upper_locgov_code , sepa.upper_locgov_nm , sepa.locgov_code , sepa.locgov_nm , itg.all_use_point , sepa.use_point from ( select clg.upper_locgov_code , clg.upper_locgov_nm , clg.locgov_code , clg.locgov_nm , sum(cntr_use_point) AS use_point FROM g_cntr_use_point up JOIN g_locgov clg ON clg.locgov_code = up.cntr_locgov_code WHERE 1=1 AND substr(point_use_de, 1,8) < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYYMMDD') AND substr(point_use_de, 1,8) >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY') || '0101' GROUP BY clg.locgov_code ) sepa ,( select sum(cntr_use_point) AS all_use_point FROM g_cntr_use_point up JOIN g_locgov clg ON clg.locgov_code = up.cntr_locgov_code WHERE 1=1 AND substr(point_use_de, 1,8) < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYYMMDD') AND substr(point_use_de, 1,8) >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY') || '0101' ) itg order by locgov_code

INSERT INTO B_GIFT_CAT( cntr_ymd ,upper_locgov_code ,upper_locgov_nm ,locgov_code ,locgov_nm ,gift_cat ,gift_cnt ,cntr_rate ) SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYYMMDD') CNTR_YMD , CLG.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE , CLG.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM , CLG.LOCGOV_CODE , CLG.LOCGOV_NM , base.txt gift_cnt , NVL(rs.regCnt,0) gift_cnt , TO_CHAR(NVL(rs.rate,0)) as cntr_rate from ( select r2.locgov_code ,r1.txt ,r1.ord from ( SELECT '농축산물' AS txt , 1 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '가공식품' AS txt , 2 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '관광서비스' AS txt , 3 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '생활용품' AS txt , 4 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '수산물' AS txt , 5 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '지역상품권' AS txt , 6 AS ord FROM db_root ) as r1 cross join ( select locgov_code FROM g_locgov where use_at = 'Y' ) r2 ) base left outer join ( SELECT T2.locgov_code , T2.name , T2.regCnt , format((T2.regCnt*1.0) / (sum(T2.regCnt)over(PARTITION BY T2.locgov_code)*1.0) * 100, 1) AS rate FROM ( select t1.locgov_code , t1.name , sum(t1.cnt) AS regCnt from ( select os.locgov_code , ocg.name , count(oi.item_id) AS cnt FROM op_item oi INNER JOIN op_item_category oic on oi.item_id = oic.item_id INNER JOIN op_category oc on oic.category_id = oc.category_id INNER JOIN op_category_group ocg on oc.category_group_id = ocg.category_group_id INNER JOIN op_seller os on oi.seller_id = os.seller_id INNER JOIN g_locgov gl on os.locgov_code = gl.locgov_code where 1 = 1 AND oi.data_status_code IN ('30', '0', '1') GROUP BY os.locgov_code , ocg.name ) AS t1 GROUP by locgov_code , name ) AS T2 ) AS rs on rs.locgov_code = base.locgov_code AND rs.name = base.txt LEFT JOIN g_locgov clg ON clg.locgov_code = base.locgov_code order by CLG.LOCGOV_CODE , base.ord

insert into B_GIFT_CAT_SELL ( CNTR_YMD , upper_locgov_code , upper_locgov_nm , locgov_code , locgov_nm , gift_cat , cntr_order_cnt , cntr_rate ) select CNTR_YMD , upper_locgov_code , upper_locgov_nm , locgov_code , locgov_nm , gift_cat , regCnt as cntr_order_cnt , rate as cntr_rate from( select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYYMMDD') CNTR_YMD , clg.upper_locgov_nm AS "기부지자체광역지역" -- 기부지자체광역지역 , concat(clg.upper_locgov_nm, ' ', clg.locgov_nm) AS "기부지자체" -- 기부지자체코드 , clg.upper_locgov_code , clg.upper_locgov_nm , clg.locgov_code , clg.locgov_nm , base.txt as gift_cat , base.ord , NVL(rs.regCnt,0) as regCnt , TO_CHAR(NVL(rs.rate,0)) as rate from ( select r2.locgov_code ,r1.txt ,r1.ord from ( SELECT '농축산물' AS txt , 1 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '가공식품' AS txt , 2 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '관광서비스' AS txt , 3 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '생활용품' AS txt , 4 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '수산물' AS txt , 5 AS ord FROM db_root UNION all SELECT '지역상품권' AS txt , 6 AS ord FROM db_root ) as r1 cross join ( select locgov_code FROM g_locgov where use_at = 'Y' ) r2 ) base left outer join ( SELECT T2.locgov_code , T2.name , T2.sCnt as regCnt , format((T2.sCnt*1.0) / (sum(T2.sCnt)over(PARTITION BY T2.locgov_code)*1.0) * 100, 1) AS rate FROM ( --------------------------------------------- select t1.locgov_code , t1.name , sCnt AS sCnt , sAmt from ( select os.locgov_code , ocg.name , sum(ooi.order_quantity) AS sCnt , sum(ooi.sale_price) AS sAmt FROM op_order_item AS ooi LEFT outer JOIN op_user_birthday oud ON ooi.user_id = oud.user_id INNER join op_item oi on ooi.item_id = oi.item_id INNER JOIN op_item_category oic on oi.item_id = oic.item_id INNER JOIN op_category oc on oic.category_id = oc.category_id INNER JOIN op_category_group ocg on oc.category_group_id = ocg.category_group_id INNER JOIN op_seller os on oi.seller_id = os.seller_id INNER JOIN g_locgov gl on os.locgov_code = gl.locgov_code where 1 = 1 AND oi.data_status_code IN ('30', '0', '1') GROUP BY os.locgov_code , ocg.name ) AS t1 GROUP by locgov_code , name ) AS T2 ) AS rs on rs.locgov_code = base.locgov_code AND rs.name = base.txt LEFT JOIN g_locgov clg ON clg.locgov_code = base.locgov_code order by "기부지자체" , base.ord )

insert into B_GIFT_DELI( CNTR_YMD , upper_locgov_code , upper_locgov_nm , locgov_code , locgov_nm , seller_id , gift_nm , DELI_TM ) select CNTR_YMD , upper_locgov_code , upper_locgov_nm , locgov_code , locgov_nm , company_name as seller_id , item_name as gift_nm , "평균소요" as DELI_TM from( select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYYMMDD') CNTR_YMD , T.upper_locgov_code , T.upper_locgov_nm , T.locgov_code , T.locgov_nm , T.company_name , T.item_name , CAST(format(avg("발송시간"), 1) AS numeric(15,2)) AS "평균소요" , rownum AS rnum FROM ( select gl.upper_locgov_code , gl.upper_locgov_nm , gl.locgov_code , gl.locgov_nm , os.company_name , (TO_TIMESTAMP(oi.shipping_date,'yyyymmddHH24MISS')-TO_TIMESTAMP(oi.sales_date,'yyyymmddHH24MISS'))/3600 AS "발송시간" , TO_TIMESTAMP(oi.shipping_date,'yyyymmddHH24MISS') , TO_TIMESTAMP(oi.sales_date,'yyyymmddHH24MISS') , oi.shipping_date , oi.sales_date , oi.item_name FROM op_order_item oi INNER JOIN op_seller os ON oi.seller_id = os.seller_id LEFT JOIN g_locgov gl ON oi.locgov_code = gl.locgov_code WHERE 1=1 AND substr(oi.sales_date, 1,4) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY') AND oi.order_status = '40' AND substr(oi.shipping_date, 1,4) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY') AND length(oi.shipping_date) = 14 AND length(oi.sales_date) = 14 ) AS T GROUP by T.locgov_code , T.company_name ORDER BY rnum, "평균소요" )

insert into B_POINT_USE ( cntr_ymd , upper_locgov_code , upper_locgov_nm , locgov_code , locgov_nm , sum_cre_pnt , sum_use_pnt , sum_pnt , sum_del_pnt , use_rate ) select cntr_ymd , upper_locgov_code , upper_locgov_nm , locgov_code , locgov_nm , sum_cre_pnt , sum_use_pnt , sum_pnt , sum_del_pnt , use_rate from( SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYYMMDD') CNTR_YMD , gl.upper_locgov_nm AS "기부지자체광역지역" -- "기부지자체광역지역" ,concat(gl.upper_locgov_nm, ' ', gl.locgov_nm) AS "기부지자체" ,gl.upper_locgov_code ,gl.upper_locgov_nm ,gl.locgov_code ,gl.locgov_nm ,gc.cntr_point AS sum_cre_pnt , cup.cntr_use_point AS sum_use_pnt , cntr_point - cntr_use_point AS sum_pnt , 0 as sum_del_pnt , format((cup.cntr_use_point*1.0) / (sum(gc.cntr_point)over(PARTITION BY gl.locgov_code)*1.0) * 100, 1) as use_rate FROM ( SELECT cntr_locgov_code , sum(cntr_point) AS cntr_point FROM g_cntr WHERE 1=1 AND cntr_sttus_code = '200' GROUP BY cntr_locgov_code ) gc JOIN g_locgov gl ON gl.locgov_code = gc.cntr_locgov_code JOIN ( SELECT cntr_locgov_code , sum(cntr_use_point) AS cntr_use_point FROM g_cntr_use_point up WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY cntr_locgov_code ) AS cup ON gc.cntr_locgov_code = cup.cntr_locgov_code --AND gc.cntr_sn = cup.cntr_sn WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY "기부지자체",gl.locgov_code )

insert into B_POINT_USE_YEAR( CNTR_YY , upper_locgov_code , upper_locgov_nm , locgov_code , locgov_nm , SUM_CRE_PNT ) select CNTR_YY , upper_locgov_code , upper_locgov_nm , locgov_code , locgov_nm , SUM_CRE_PNT from ( SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY') CNTR_YY , gl.upper_locgov_nm AS "기부지자체광역지역" , concat(gl.upper_locgov_nm, ' ', gl.locgov_nm) AS "기부지자체" , gl.upper_locgov_code , gl.upper_locgov_nm , gl.locgov_code , gl.locgov_nm , gc.cntr_point AS SUM_CRE_PNT FROM ( SELECT cntr_locgov_code , sum(cntr_point) AS cntr_point FROM g_cntr WHERE 1=1 AND substr(cntr_de,1,4) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY') AND cntr_sttus_code = '200' GROUP BY cntr_locgov_code ) gc JOIN g_locgov gl ON gl.locgov_code = gc.cntr_locgov_code WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY "기부지자체",gl.locgov_code )

insert into B_POINT_YEAR( cntr_yy ,upper_locgov_code ,upper_locgov_nm ,locgov_code ,locgov_nm , crePnt , use1 , use2 , use3 , use4 , exPnt ) select cntr_yy , upper_locgov_code , upper_locgov_nm , locgov_code , locgov_nm , crePnt , use1 , use2 , use3 , use4 , exPnt from ( SELECT /*+ ordered use_merge (gc) */ TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY') CNTR_YY , gl.upper_locgov_code , gl.upper_locgov_nm , gl.locgov_code , gl.locgov_nm , CONCAT(gl.upper_locgov_nm, ' ', gl.locgov_nm) AS "기부지자체" , gc.cntr_yy AS 연도 , SUM(gc.cntr_point) AS crePnt , SUM(gc.cntr_point) AS 발생포인트 , SUM(NVL(cup.use_point_2023, 0)) AS use1 , SUM(NVL(cup.use_point_2024, 0)) AS use2 , SUM(NVL(cup.use_point_2025, 0)) AS use3 , SUM(NVL(cup.use_point_2026, 0)) AS use4 , SUM(gc.cntr_point) - SUM(NVL(cup.total_use_point, 0)) AS exPnt FROM ( SELECT cntr_sn , cntr_locgov_code , cntr_point , substring(cntr_de,1,4) AS cntr_yy FROM g_cntr WHERE cntr_sttus_code = '200' AND cntr_de >= '20230101' AND cntr_de < TO_CHAR(add_months(trunc(SYSDATE ,'YYYY'), 12),'YYYYMMDD') ) gc LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cntr_sn , SUM(CASE WHEN substring(point_use_de,1,4) = '2023' THEN cntr_use_point ELSE 0 END) AS use_point_2023 , SUM(CASE WHEN substring(point_use_de,1,4) = '2024' THEN cntr_use_point ELSE 0 END) AS use_point_2024 , SUM(CASE WHEN substring(point_use_de,1,4) = '2025' THEN cntr_use_point ELSE 0 END) AS use_point_2025 , SUM(CASE WHEN substring(point_use_de,1,4) = '2026' THEN cntr_use_point ELSE 0 END) AS use_point_2026 , SUM(cntr_use_point) AS total_use_point FROM g_cntr_use_point WHERE 1=1 AND point_use_de >= '20230101' AND point_use_de < TO_CHAR(add_months(trunc(SYSDATE ,'YYYY'), 12),'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY cntr_sn ) cup ON gc.cntr_sn = cup.cntr_sn /* 지자체명 조인 */ LEFT JOIN g_locgov gl ON gc.cntr_locgov_code = gl.locgov_code GROUP BY gl.upper_locgov_nm, gl.locgov_nm, gc.cntr_yy ORDER BY "기부지자체", 연도 )
